marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to light near midnight. Wind
light Friday. Scattered showers and fog patches changing to scattered
flurries this morning. Temperatures plus 3 falling to minus 2 this
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 early this evening then
subsiding to 1 or less late overnight.<br/>
